about.title:
International training,
local expertise
about.p1: Nelson Daza is a Colombian professional specializing in international affairs, legal documentation and immigration processes for foreigners who wish to live, invest, work or establish businesses in Colombia.
about.p2: He holds an international legal education from RUDN Patrice Lumumba University in Moscow, one of the most recognized universities in Eastern Europe for international relations and law. His mission: to facilitate the legal and migratory integration of foreigners in Colombia through clear, professional and personalized advice.

items.name: Visa M — Spouse of Colombian
items.desc: Legal marriage to a Colombian citizen. Includes explanatory letter, evidence of genuine relationship and cohabitation records.

items.name: Visa M — Permanent Partner
items.desc: Demonstrable marital union with a Colombian. Cohabitation evidence is the most critical element of this application.

items.name: Visa V — Digital Nomad
items.desc: For those working remotely for foreign companies: developers, designers, consultants, content creators.

items.name: Visa M — Retiree / Pensioner
items.desc: Lifelong pension equivalent to 3 Colombian minimum wages. Ideal for US, Canadian and European retirees.

items.name: Visa M — Real Estate Investor
items.desc: The most attractive visa for Santa Marta. Min. investment: 350 minimum wages (~USD 95,000). Includes Banco de la República registration.

items.name: Permanent Residency (Visa R)
items.desc: The premium product. Via time accumulation, Colombian parentage, or direct investment of 650 minimum wages (~USD 275,000).
